comments.body:
`qt6-tools` suffices:

```suggestion
pkg install qt6-base qt6-tools
```

`qt6-translations` depends on `qt6-tools`. I tried installing just `qt6-base qt6-tools` (`qt6-tools` pulled a few more deps) and compilation succeeded.
